purpose: Authoritative overrides for facts re-verified after the 2026-10-01 launch-closure snapshot. Historical evidence is preserved but must not override newer direct verification.

git_governance.verification_note: Current GitHub integration can read rulesets and observed zero rulesets, but classic branch-protection read returned an integration-permission error. Do not infer protected or unprotected from that result.

security.note: The advisor proves leaked-password protection is disabled but does not prove the project's subscription plan. HUNT currently exposes no password-auth customer flow, and recent auth logs showed only settings reads, so this warning remains open hardening rather than a HUNT payment/fulfillment launch blocker. Re-evaluate immediately if password auth is introduced.

supplier_privacy.strict_network_anonymity_reason: Supplier/CDN domains or internal provider metadata can remain discoverable to a technical user through DevTools/network paths until server-side API/media proxying is introduced.
